Model family: The cert covers 3 type variants: DS-676, DS-676H, DS-676L. Should I include model_family? The schema says include ONLY if cert covers >1 model variant. There are 3 type designations. However, characteristics are not given per model — they're general. Hmm. The type designations list includes three models. I think including model_family with models DS-676, DS-676H, DS-676L is reasonable. But attributes aren't per-model. I'll include model_family with the three models, family_name null.

Characteristics type_level:
- accuracy_class: (III) → value "III"? Value could be string "(III)". I'll use value "(III)" or "III". Canonical: value: "(III)" maybe "III". I'll use "III".
- maximum_capacity: 1.5 kg ≤ Max ≤ 30 kg → value {min: 1.5, max: 30}, unit_symbol "kg"
- verification_scale_interval: e ≥ 0.5 g → value {min: 0.5, max: null}, unit_symbol "g"
- weighing_ranges: "Single interval, Multi-interval" → value list? It's two options. Value could be string "Single interval / Multi-interval" or list. Schema says value is number | {min,max} | string. I'll use "Single interval or Multi-interval" — hmm. Maybe "Single interval, Multi-interval". I'll use value: ["Single interval", "Multi-interval"]? Schema says string; but lists aren't specified. Better keep string "Single interval / Multi-interval". Actually maybe use value: "Single interval or Multi-interval".
- maximum_number_of_scale_intervals_single_range: n ≤ 7500 → value {min: null, max: 7500}, unit_symbol null
- maximum_number_of_scale_intervals_multi_interval: n ≤ 3000 (per partial weighing range) → value {min: null, max: 3000}, note
- maximum_number_of_partial_weighing_ranges: 2
- tare: T ≤ -50% for single interval instruments; T ≤ -(Max1-e1) for multi-interval. This is config-level: axis "interval_type". Could use config_level entries:
  - attribute tare_limit, axis interval_type, values: [{condition: "single interval", value: -50, unit_symbol: "%"}, {condition: "multi-interval", value: "-(Max1-e1)", unit_symbol: null}]
  For single interval: T ≤ -50% → value {min: null, max: -50}, unit "%".
- temperature_range: -10 °C / +40 °C → {min: -10, max: 40}, unit "°C"
- Power supply: 
  - power_supply_voltage AC: 220–240 V → {min:220, max:240}, "V"; power_supply_frequency {min:50, max:60} Hz; power_supply_type "AC"
  - power_supply_voltage DC via adapter: 5–9 V DC
  - power_supply_voltage battery: 6 V DC
  These are config-level (power source). Could do config_level with axis "power_source": values: [{condition: "AC mains", value: {min:220,max:240}, unit_symbol: "V"}, {condition: "AC/DC adapter", value: {min:5,max:9}, unit_symbol: "V"}, {condition: "battery", value: 6, unit_symbol: "V"}]. And frequency config-level: only for AC mains 50/60 Hz.
- software_identification: version 1.xx where xx 00–99 → value "1.xx" string.
